rationale: No single state may exceed 12% of outstanding exposure. Geographic shocks (state-level unemployment/housing) correlate within state; a cap forces diversification.
provenance: ILLUSTRATIVE - set by us. In a real bank this comes top-down from a board-approved Risk Appetite Statement.

rationale: No single loan purpose may exceed 50% of outstanding exposure. Purpose proxies borrower motivation and correlates with default behaviour.
Top-10 states may not exceed 55% of outstanding exposure. Companion to HHI; interviewers and committees recognise Top-N without explanation.
Sub-investment-grade equivalent (LC grades E/F/G) capped at 8% of book. These grades carry the highest observed loss rates.
Purpose concentration measured on cardinality-normalised HHI. HHI* = (HHI - 10000/n)/(10000 - 10000/n); 0 = perfectly balanced.
provenance: ILLUSTRATIVE threshold. The HHI* correction itself is arithmetic; only the 0.30 line is our judgement.

rationale: Geographic concentration on normalised HHI. Tighter than purpose because geography is the dimension we can actually steer via origination policy.
Credit-quality mix concentration on normalised HHI. A book bunched into one grade has no risk-return ladder.
